attributes.residual: (1) StartShieldFX, real 64, 141/141 but multiset 6t - NOT a webfrank candidate at all. The lane brief called it a 'mixed remat+preoffset cap'; the count screen refutes that framing. The live structural gap is at +0x184..+0x194 where the target computes an array element as `mulli`/`add` then a displacement `lwz`, while ours emits `addi` then an indexed `lwzx` - the classic index-form family, and SOURCE-REACHABLE. Next agent: this is index-form work, screen claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe.20260831.v2 and the `base+i*stride` induction form; do not spend budget looking for a postprocessor rule. (2) DrawBlitFlatQuad, real 90, 142/142, multiset identical: the single differing cluster spans +0x5c..+0x1c4 with 77 of its 91 words differing and a control instruction at +0x1ac inside it, so the largest control-free window is +0x5c..+0x1ac. Over that window an exhaustive search of relocation-consistent, form-legal complete matchings (capped at 200,000, all refused) hits def-use chains on f6, f3, f0 and f1 in every case - the FPR arithmetic in this region is genuinely data-dependent and cannot be reordered into the target's sequence. DO-NOT-RETRY the permute axis on this function; the search was exhaustive within the window, and the only remaining path is the source-level one the SL record already named.
